text: Kingsmoor FC wins the ball near their own goal on the left side through Andre Fairweather's interception. The team moves the ball forward with a series of passes, advancing from deep in their half through midfield towards Westport Albion’s goal at the far end. On the right flank, Felix Duarte sends a medium cross into the penalty area about 9 metres from goal, finding Viktor Quinlan, who combines with Duarte before receiving a key pass back. Quinlan shoots with his foot from 8.6 metres out, scoring to extend Kingsmoor FC’s lead to 2-0. [#211] [#218] [#220] [#222]
